# Will a trampoline park make money? Monthly profit, payback and break-even fill

> Free calculator for trampoline parks and family entertainment centers. Enter jumper capacity, sessions, fill, ticket price, birthday parties, memberships, staff, rent and the build; it shows monthly profit, margin, payback, break-even fill and the lowest ticket for your target margin and payback.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
